company.name: Sajilni
company.shortDescription: Sajilni is an event management and e-ticketing platform for the Middle East.
company.description:
Sajilni is an OASIS500 Company established in Amman - Jordan.   At Sajilni, you will FIND all the events, courses and activities your city has to offer; from business training or cooking courses to sporting events or exhibitions; all in one place! You can then review, register and pay all from the comfort of your home! 

Sajilni is for anyone planning to attend or organize an event. 

If you're looking to ORGANIZE an event, sell tickets online, Sajilni empowers you as Event Organizers to become more efficient and effective when bringing people together. That's why they've created tools that make it easy to sell tickets, accept payment, manage attendees, extract reports and send invitations to all kinds of events- whether it's a photography class or a fast selling concert, an inspiring conference, a football tournament or your private party !!
